0dc08c27518b: Salesforce Time Slot Picker: Dates and Times in One Calendar
caecbcc46e40: Add a calendar time slot picker to any Salesforce Screen Flow or page. Pick many dates, drag the hours, stop double-booking, and save to your objects. No Apex.
10691eb9dfc5: A Salesforce date and time slot picker Lightning Web Component. Users pick many dates on one calendar, then drag time slots in a grid or choose them from dropdowns, shared across every date or different per date. Includes conflict detection (block, skip or allow), Morning, Afternoon and Evening periods, status colors, consolidated time spans with sub-blocks, a Time Grid Only mode, Week, Calendar and Agenda views, and Flow outputs such as selectedDatesWithTimesJson. Works in Screen Flows, Lightning Record Pages, App Pages, Home Pages and Experience Cloud sites, set up in a Setup Wizard with no Apex.

905a4f12c134: MultiDatePick Date Time: Salesforce Date and Time Slot Picker
4febef3719b8: How the MultiDatePick Date Time component works in Salesforce: time grid vs dropdown, shared vs per-date times, periods, conflict detection, status colors, how records save, Flow outputs and the full properties reference.
6fb0eeebd1e2: How do I add a time slot picker to a Salesforce Screen Flow?
c2c93c9d22d5: In Flow Builder, open a Screen, search MultiDatePick, drag the Dates & Times component on and set Config Name to the config you built in the Setup Wizard. Every checkbox comes from the config. The component saves its own records when the config names a child object, or you wire Dates With Times JSON (Output) to a text variable, run the Parse Date Entries from JSON action, loop the entries and create one record each.
b6212fee3984: Can each date have different times?
77fe97bba215: Yes. Turn on Allow Different Times Per Date and every selected date gets its own time grid or dropdown, grouped by week. Leave it off and one shared grid applies the same hours to every date you picked.
b384629f07a7: Yes. Conflict Behavior defaults to block: slots already taken by existing records on that calendar are grayed out and cannot be picked. Skip saves the open slots and reports the taken ones, which suits batch picking across many dates. Allow turns checking off. Conflict Look-Ahead Days sets how far ahead it checks, 360 days by default.
3156cfcceaf5: Can I use dropdowns instead of a time grid?
331322ac0f49: Yes. Set Time Display Mode to dropdown for start and end time pickers, or keep grid for clickable slots you can drag across. Time Interval sets the slot size in minutes, any interval you like (15, 30 or 60 are typical), and Earliest Time and Latest Time bound the day, 08:00 to 18:00 by default.
d19c11ee4d96: Does the Salesforce date and time picker work on Experience Cloud, App and Home pages?
d5cae751145e: Yes. On App, Home and Experience Cloud pages set Config Name plus Static Parent Record Id, the record the times belong to. On Experience Cloud, turn on Show In-Component Toast so visitors see the save confirmation.
ea726c430ccc: What does the MultiDatePick Date Time component cost?
12b1b55edab3: MultiDatePick is one plan at $20 per user per month with a 30-day free trial and no card required. Date Time, Date and Booking are all included, with every feature.
